name: WH40KRP
description: A general theme for any game system: grimdark gothic, near-black and bone with dark bronze and a deep red, Grenze Gotisch headings, Spectral text and Share Tech Mono labels, a black band, a skull over laurels, pointed arches and a dossier with a Clearance stamp. An unofficial, fan-made look, not affiliated with or endorsed by the owners of the work or game it is named after.
